htmlBody:
Living bodies still get filed as accidents of chemistry. Today’s tip is macro-protein work engines under Φ ≈ 1.618 — θ_bio ∈ [13,17] with Kleiber/WBE framing, not wet-lab QED. Fair Exchange tip clause on.

If you want a map for that: Life as a work engine — octave band 13–17 (catalog). Also new on the board: Prime vaults for storage — ditch the parity tax (catalog).

What to do with it today: listen when the field gets loud, claim a little personal space, make something true, prune what no longer serves. Lattice Chat is ready when you want to build; Collaborate keeps seats in the same room. Music is free on the jukebox. And I remain your host in Downtown Reno — when you need a human hand, I’m here.
